$comment: Functional taxonomy for the mini-app UI catalog. Vocabulary only — which component belongs to which family is declared per component in its JSDoc `@family` tag and read by scripts/gen/skill/index.mjs; scripts/check/skill.mjs fails on an unknown or missing family. Order here is the catalog order.

families.name: Layout & structure
families.blurb: Shell / split / scroll containers and display atoms — they arrange, they don't interact.

families.name: Navigation
families.blurb: Menus, sidebars, palettes, tabs, pagination, scroll-spy.

families.name: Surface
families.blurb: Elevates content above the page: card, dialog, sheet, drawer, popover, tooltip, accordion.

families.name: Form
families.blurb: Inputs, selects, toggles, buttons and actions — anything the user edits.

families.name: Data & tables
families.blurb: Rows, grids, boards, trees, sortable lists and their filters.

families.name: Chart & data
families.blurb: Stat / KPI cards, charts, gauges, sparklines, git graph.

families.name: Feedback & status
families.blurb: Status/severity badges, progress, skeleton, spinner, alerts, empty states, toasts.

families.name: Calendar & date
families.blurb: Calendars, date/time pickers and ranges, durations, timezones, scheduling views.

families.name: Realtime
families.blurb: Live feeds, timelines, logs and consoles.

families.name: Rich text
families.blurb: Markdown / rich-text render and edit, wiki markup.

families.name: Discovery & inspect
families.blurb: Inspect, compare and browse artefacts: diff, JSON, code, requests, attachments.

families.name: Animation
families.blurb: Entrance / exit / layout motion: reveal, stagger, animated presence.
